title: UKCEH regional replication of the lake radius-of-gyration prediction
status: Prospective regional protocol; commit before any real radius or exponent calculation. The commit time is authoritative.
relationship_to_original: Separate regional replication, not a replacement for the global HydroLAKES preregistration.
prior_exposure: The global lake prediction and published lake-area exponents were known.
The UKCEH archive, schema, feature count, ring structure and publisher documentation were inspected before this protocol.
No UKCEH radius, radius-selected sample count, spatial-block count, fitted exponent or hypothesis verdict has been computed or inspected.

data.source: Taylor, P.J. (2021), Spatial inventory of UK waterbodies v3.6, UKCEH, doi:10.5285/b6b92ce3-dcd7-4f0b-8e43-e937ddf1d4eb
data.license: Open Government Licence; attribute UKCEH and Ordnance Survey as stated by the publisher.

geometry.measure: Uniform planar area on all polygon components, subtracting every interior ring; Rg about the full geometry centroid.
geometry.invalid_geometry_policy: Abort for invalid WKB, nonfinite or unclosed coordinates, duplicate/missing WBID, nonpositive component area or second moment. No silent repairs or exclusions. Self-intersection, ring containment and component-overlap topology are not tested.

hypothesis.reference_measure: log-orthopolic territory allocation per d ln R

analysis.block_rule: floor(centroid east/100000), floor(centroid north/100000), applied after radius selection; sample K occupied cells uniformly with replacement, retaining all lakes in each sampled cell.
analysis.gof_rule: Bounded KS parametric bootstrap with refitting; descriptive iid diagnostic, p <= 0.1 flags inadequacy; not a spatially calibrated significance test.

decision.insufficient: Fewer than 100 selected lakes or fewer than 10 occupied blocks, or either interval unavailable.
decision.supports: Both 95% intervals lie within [1.9, 2.1]. This is conditional exponent agreement, not proof of territory allocation.
decision.adequacy_qualification: Record the exponent decision separately. If the iid goodness-of-fit diagnostic rejects the power law, describe the fitted exponent only and make no positive support claim. Non-rejection does not establish adequacy.

limitations: A UK inventory is a regional observation, not global coverage or an independent replication dataset without geographical overlap.
Most outlines date to about 1993 with selective revisions; small ponds are poorly represented and some large lakes are split into basins.
R >= 1 km does not guarantee area-based detection completeness for elongated lakes.
No reservoir classification is supplied; no natural-only sensitivity or classification inferred from names.
British National Grid distances have projection distortion; this analysis uses the supplied metric coordinates without claiming geodesic exactness.
A fixed 100 km grid does not guarantee independence, and blocks differ in lake count. No alternate origin or block size will be selected after seeing outcomes.
The geometric feature, including any mapped split basins, is the observation unit; no outcome-driven joining is permitted.
